name: optcatalog_handle_impact_from_runtime_probe
description: OptCatalog::HandleImpactFromRuntimeProbe processes hit-list entries, applies distance-scaled runtime damage, skips an excluded damage handler, and dispatches or queues impact handling.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to the OptCatalog/zWeapon runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b0a50 validates ECX as OptCatalogEntryDef*, EDX as OptCatalogRuntimeInstanceStorage*, stack arguments for hitList then excludedDamageHandler, damage-handler exclusion via node free-list offset 0xbc, distance-scaled or full damage selection from entry flags, runtime spawnScale multiplication, immediate InvokeDamageFeedbackAndHitCallback dispatch, delayed queue insertion up to 64 records, and nonzero return when any hit was processed.
The native smoke verifies immediate callback dispatch with distance-scaled damage and that a matching excluded damage handler skips the hit.
